How points work

  • Every Stacked(project, trader, imd, shares) event from the Stacker is read from the chain in block chunks, starting at the Stacker's deployment block.
  • Only events whose project is in projects.json, at or after that project's fromBlock, earn points: 1 point per IMD stacked.
  • Everything else is shown as direct, no points. It still stacks real tsIMD to the trader.
  • Leaderboards only count listed projects. Recent stacks list every event.

Static page, no backend: reads go to public Sepolia RPCs, transactions go through your wallet.
